metadata.description: Model- and Python-friendly conversion of the complete Migrate Studio rule workbook. Rule, candidate, and parameter objects are keyed by ID; large audit sections remain arrays with lookup indexes for efficient access.

C-001.description: Creates permanent SDTM.SUPPAE output copies directly from WORK.SUPPAE. Apply only if the migration requires these additional native SDTM datasets; the pattern occurs only in t900ae.sas.
conditions_list: AE/SUPPAE output block.

C-002.description: Replaces generic `%util_getdata` reads with direct reads from native SDTM datasets. Apply only under the consolidated conditions and variants supported by the evidence from EXAMPLE003 SDTM.
C-002.after_pattern_variants:
Variant 1: data tv; set sdtm.tv; run;

Variant 2: data sv; set sdtm.sv; run;
conditions_list: SV program native SDTM read.

C-003.description: Adds `options mprint mlogic nofmterr missing='';` before the startup include in u900adpc.sas. Apply only with human confirmation because the files do not establish why this option set is unique to that program.
conditions_list: Observed only in u900adpc.sas.

C-004.description: Redirects the demonstrated ADSL `%util_getdata` read from `libref=data` to `libref=ADaM` and adds `engine=V9`. Apply only with human confirmation because the evidence does not show why this one read needs the extra engine option.
conditions_list: Observed only in l900eg01.sas.

C-005.description: Expands the autoexec date setup by adding `studyid` and `datacut` while preserving the existing `cutdate` value. Apply only to the TLF autoexec study/date variable block; this pattern occurs once.
conditions_list: TLF autoexec study/date macro-variable initialization.

C-006.description: Comments out the ADLB validation-library assignment, validation DATA step, and PROC COMPARE block in the SCE version. Apply only after human review because the files show the disabling action but do not establish whether it is an OS requirement, a platform requirement, or a study-specific validation decision.
C-006.before_pattern_variants: libname vadam ...; data vadlb; set vadam.vadlb; ... proc compare base=padam.adlb compare=vadam.vadlb ...;
conditions_list: Observed only in adlb.sas.

C-007.description: Comments out the legacy direct `mheadfoot.sas` include inside the TLF autoexec. Apply only if per-program MHEADFOOT loading is intentionally used instead; this exact autoexec-level pattern occurs once.
C-007.conditions: TLF autoexec only; paired report/listing programs add the active SCE include under R-EXAMPLE002-TLF-006.
conditions_list: TLF autoexec only; paired report/listing programs add the active SCE include under R-EXAMPLE002-TLF-006.

C-008.description: Replaces the legacy VAL validation-data LIBNAME path with the SCE study-root validation path. Apply to the active VAL LIBNAME assignment in the study autoexec.
conditions_list: Active VAL LIBNAME in autoexec.sas

C-009.description: Replaces the legacy PG validation-program LIBNAME path with the SCE study-root validation path. Apply to the active PG LIBNAME assignment in the study autoexec.
conditions_list: Active PG LIBNAME in autoexec.sas

C-010.description: Changes the demonstrated PROC TRANSPOSE statement terminator from `;;` to `;`. Apply only after human review because the same doubled terminator is retained in another paired program and the change is not established as a migration requirement.
C-010.before_pattern_variants: proc transpose data = suppds(keep = usubjid idvarval qnam qval) out = suppds_t(drop = _name_ _label_);;
C-010.after_pattern_variants: proc transpose data = suppds(keep = usubjid idvarval qnam qval) out = suppds_t(drop = _name_ _label_);
C-010.conditions: Observed only in l900ds03.sas; l900ic01.sas retains the doubled terminator.
C-010.exceptions: l900ic01.sas retains the same doubled terminator.
conditions_list: Observed only in l900ds03.sas; l900ic01.sas retains the doubled terminator.

C-011.description: Changes the TLF macro-root value from the legacy relative directory to `&targetStudy.\Dev\Programs\TLF\primary\macros`. Apply only to the TLF autoexec configuration; this pattern occurs in one paired program.
conditions_list: TLF autoexec macro-root assignment.

C-012.description: Changes both `_output` and the OUT libref from the legacy relative TLF output directory to `&targetStudy.\Dev\Output\TLF`. Apply only to the paired TLF autoexec output-location block; this combined pattern occurs once.
conditions_list: TLF autoexec output initialization.

C-013.description: Changes the TRANS XPORT LIBNAME from `&__SDTMLIB/&data..xpt` to the SCE study SDTM data folder. Apply to the XPT export LIBNAME used by the autoexec conversion macro.
conditions_list: TRANS XPORT LIBNAME in autoexec.sas

C-014.description: Splits one `%util_getdata` call that requests both SS and ADSL from `libref=data` into separate SS/Data and ADSL/ADaM calls. Apply only when a single source call mixes members that belong to different SCE data layers.
C-014.after_pattern_variants:
%util_getdata(ss, libref=Data, sort=usubjid, engine=V9);
%util_getdata(adsl, libref=ADaM, sort=usubjid, engine=V9);
conditions_list: Observed only in u900tte.sas.

C-015.description: Changes the L-DEATH RTF filename from `&pgmname..rtf` to `&pgmname._test.rtf`. Apply only to the MA_Testing version of `l-death.sas`; this naming change occurs once.
conditions_list: MA_Testing/l-death.sas output only.

C-016.description: Changes the T-LB-LC-SAF source from `vadam.vadlb` to `padam.adlb` while preserving the same WHERE condition. Apply only when the validated target intentionally uses PADAM rather than the validation ADAM source; this source-selection pattern occurs once.
C-016.conditions: MA_Testing/t-lb-lc-saf.sas; requires human confirmation of the intended source library.
conditions_list: MA_Testing/t-lb-lc-saf.sas; requires human confirmation of the intended source library.
